notes.title: Update Log: 1.2.0
notes.notes:
We been enhancing the game and polishing the experience daily as we receive play testing feedback. Check this log for the many small changes made that make the game more fun:

 Spawns some logs on downed crew members
 Crew Logs interface - for later reading
 Crew Logs should correctly spawn procedurally in all rooms & floors (not 100% certain)
 Pause button moved to [Spacebar]
 Should fix several instances of getting stuck on maps at the entrance: Press the "Insert" key if you are stuck to generate an error code, take a screenshot, and let us know so we can fix it
 Adds a chance to find missed Crew Logs in Lockers
 Enhances all Xenomorph A.I.
 Greatly Enhanced Space Dragon A.I.
 Space Dragons now regenerate while sleeping
 Space Dragon "flipping" should be reduced
 Fixes spacing in the "Continue Game" window
 Should fix instances of the camera starting in darkened areas of the map
 Reduced number of starting Stasis Mines to X1
 Fixes Stasis Field effect
 Should fix (old) downed crew targeting bug
 Fixes missing text and timing issues in the Introduction
 Stasis Cages now effect unhatched Eggs 
 Increased chance of finding skipped logs in lockers on the next floor
 Decreased the decay time of egg husks 
 Should finally fix getting stuck at the start of any floor
 Friends with Jonesy Leaderboard is now live
 Fixes Jonesy sometimes going missing/ghostly after winning 10-floors 
 Mines no longer persist across floors
 Moonbase Down Report Achievement: Now correctly triggered once Crew Log window is full 
 Raises the character level cap to 30
 Hard Mode: adds 'mysterious' layer of difficulty after surviving 10-Floors 

Please report any bugs or great suggestions in Steam discussions.

notes.title: Moonbase Down: Released & Update #1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32853264/0b4004af44ad68441d436fe75cf9a4f687ca2f15.png

Turn down the lights... and Welcome to the Cruel World of Moonbase Down. 

Moonbase Down Arcade mode is up and running smoothly now, and with that Early Access begins!

If you encounter any bugs or problems while playing, let us know ASAP in comments (or Discussions). We will hot fix any issue you report within 24-hours, if we are able to find it. 

Beyond MBD 1.0 

This is only the beginning for Moonbase Down! Features will be added to Arcade mode over time. Once Sandbox mode is deep enough to be fun, it will also be released and updated for a long time to come.   

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32853264/a1ec99ac0f36d49c0117b3965bb637f96cc030b7.png 

What modes do I get right now when I buy Moonbase Down? 
Arcade mode and Unlimited mode, with Steam Leaderboards.

Is Arcade / Unlimited Mode a finished game? 
Yes, you are getting a full featured arcade game right now. But, we plan to add even more to arcade mode and roll out sandbox mode through updates or DLC.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32853264/dc4fdacb6e97cdef98019a6025073abcc2e2dedd.png

What is Sandbox Mode? 
Moonbase Down sandbox mode will take the survival struggle to the surface of the Moon and inner solar system. Currently under development.   

When will Sandbox Mode be released? 
We do not have a date for the first release. The plan is now to have Sandbox Mode release by late 2023.

Moonbase Down 1.0.96 is released [10/29/18] 

 Stasis Mines x5 - Player now gets 5x mines when first grabbing them
 Added: Class Leaderboards - which key off the number of logs found

Please let us know in Discussions if you encounter any problems whatsoever. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/870590/Moonbase_Down/

Thank you so much!
AdventRPG
GM-X
